messages:
incident-bot: SEV:high — multiple serving-runtime pods in prod hit OOMKilled; CPU spikes detected on tokenizer worker containers. Dashboard: https://grafana.redwood.example.com/d/abcd/serving-runtime?orgId=1

emma (eng-oncall): paging @raj — looks like several pods killed in us-west-2 cluster, service degraded, seeing 502/503s. starting triage.

raj (sre): on it. grabbing pod events + dmesg. can someone paste a sample pod name?

maria (prodeng): generator-57f9c6b7-xxq2 and tokenizer-6bd9f8c4-hkz2 both OOMKilled around 1713604700. saw a jump in request size from a few customers (long system prompts).

kevin (support): Tickets incoming — customer ACME reported timeouts ~ 13:11 UTC, ticket #INC-4129. they reported a large batch of prompts from an import job.

emma (eng-oncall): copying kube events and container logs below:
```
$ kubectl describe pod tokenizer-6bd9f8c4-hkz2 -n prod
Events:
  Type     Reason     Age   From               Message
  ----     ------     ----  ----               -------
  Warning  OOMKilled  3m    kubelet, ip-10-0-0-45  Container "tokenizer" was killed due to OOMKilled
```

```
$ kubectl logs tokenizer-6bd9f8c4-hkz2 -c tokenizer -n prod --previous
Killed process 2783 (python) total-vm:102400kB, anon-rss:98000kB, file-rss:0kB
Memory cgroup out of memory: Kill process 2783 (python) score 309 or sacrifice child
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/app/tokenizer_worker.py", line 214, in handle_request
    tokens = tokenizer.encode(request.text)
  File "/venv/lib/python3.10/site-packages/fasttokenizer/__init__.py", line 98, in encode
    buf = allocate(len(request.text) * 4)
MemoryError
```

raj (sre): dmesg from node shows multiple "Out of memory" and processes killed: `python`, `node`. looks like tokenizer allocate path is unbounded for extremely long inputs.

emma (eng-oncall): initial impact assessment: error spikes in serving-api -> 30% increase in 5xx across text-generation routes for ~18 minutes. estimated 3 customers affected with >=2% request failures.

opsbot: Incident created: INC-202403/1713604823. Severity: S2. On-call: raj.

raj (sre): mitigation plan: 1) drain pods from the node(s) with repeated OOMs; 2) add a temporary admission control to reject requests with token_count > 100k; 3) patch tokenizer container to pre-check input size and fail fast with 413; 4) roll tracer/slow-path limits. executing now.

maria (prodeng): rolling a config change to prod will be quick. preparing a deploy that sets ENV MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=8192 and enables fast-fail. will push canary to 2 pods.

emma (eng-oncall): command to cordon node: `kubectl cordon ip-10-0-0-45` — please do that for nodes with repeated OOMs.

raj (sre): cordoned ip-10-0-45 and drained tokenizer pods. also added a temporary PodDisruptionBudget to allow replacement.

maria (prodeng): canary patch applied to tokenizer- canary-1, tokenizer- canary-2. logs show requests exceeding new limit are returning 413. sample log:
```
WARN request_rejected: input_tokens=163842 > MAX_INPUT_TOKENS=8192 for req id=abc-12345
```

kevin (support): replied to ACME with temporary workaround: limit batch size on import, backoff and retry. assigned INC-4129 to SE team for follow-up.

emma (eng-oncall): traffic back to ~normal for generation routes. 5xx rate down to baseline after rollout and restarts. tagging incident as "mitigated" for immediate customer impact.

opsbot: Postmortem checklist created. Assigned owner: maria (prodeng).

raj (sre): quick root-cause summary: tokenizer library allocates based on input length without enforced guardrails; a small number of very large prompts from one integration caused sustained high memory allocations on tokenizer process leading to kernel OOM and OOMKills across pods on one node, causing cascading restarts and temporary capacity loss.

maria (prodeng): follow-ups (short): 1) ship permanent admission controller (rate + token limits) by EOD; 2) add per-container memory request/limit tuning and hard caps; 3) add a pre-tokenize streaming path to avoid big allocations; 4) add synthetic tests for huge prompt shapes in CI.

emma (eng-oncall): customer impact note for postmortem: 3 customers saw degraded performance, 1 customer (ACME) hit ~5min of 503s during their import job. will coordinate SRE + support to draft customer message.

kevin (support): will send preliminary outreach to ACME with mitigation and ETA for fix.

raj (sre): handing on-call to emma for monitoring window. I'll stay available for escalation. last check: nodes healthy, pods stable.

emma (eng-oncall): ack — taking over. monitoring for 30m. adding runbook entry: 
- when tokenizer OOMs detected: cordon node -> drain -> deploy fast-fail patch -> scale up if persistent -> open support ticket.

opsbot: Incident INC-202403/1713604823 status: mitigated -> monitoring.

maria (prodeng): will own postmortem doc and schedule follow-up with infra + sdk teams.

kevin (support): updating ticket INC-4129 and linking to incident.

emma (eng-oncall): thanks everyone. please add any stray logs or customer notes to the incident doc. :thumbsup:
